title: Organisation
description: A peace-building organisation referenced from one or more conflict pages. Real entries live in data/organisations/<id>.json. Shared field formats are in defs.schema.json.

id.description: URL-safe identifier used to link from conflict pages, e.g. "corrymeela-community".

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the primary country the organisation operates in.

mission.description: Short, neutral description of the organisation's mission.

contact.description: Public-facing contact channel (contact page URL or mailto: address), not a fundraising link.

linkedInitiatives.description: Names of initiatives (from conflict pages) this organisation runs.

sourcesCheckedOn.description: ISO date when the organisation page's external links were last validated.
